summary: Routed-datapath LVS was refused by klt before a compare: the gate-level-verilog reader rejects the reference netlist's Yosys escaped module name. The dbu and reference.form refusals recorded in item4-slice-attempt.r2.json are gone. No report exists; this is not a match and not evidence of one.
note: ASAP7 is predictive; tool result only. Append-only; item4-slice-attempt.r2.json and item4-attempts.json are left as written. The netlist, layout and deck were not edited and no option was waived.
request_notes: pdk_root and pin_order_files point at the pinned lambdapdk v0.2.17 tree (archive sha256 ac7e950c4d0394a829658b6e219fea4a4b0c61a998183d5520f8b9e38c6efff2, unpacked in /tmp scratch, not committed). pin_order_files names asap7sc7p5t_rvt/netlist/asap7sc7p5t_28_R.cdl because reference.library looks for spice/ or cdl/ directories that this tree does not have.
klt_message: could not convert gate-level-verilog reference netlist to plain-element form: 'module' declaration uses an escaped identifier ("\\$paramod\\rx_cdc_fifo\\W=s32'00000000000000000000000001000000"), which this reader does not support (e.g. a Yosys '\$paramod$<hash>\<name>' module); flatten the netlist or rename the module first
not_done: The netlist was not flattened or renamed: that would change the hashed reference input and belongs to the synthesis step (#17's output), not to this evidence. Follow-up is a decision for that step or an upstream fix.
